questions.prompt: Which of the following is the parent linear function?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The parent linear function is $ f(x) = x $.
hints: The parent function is the simplest form, with slope 1 and y-intercept 0.
Look for the equation with no added numbers.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: A constant function is a horizontal line.
questions.prompt: The graph of a constant function is a straight line that is ___ (horizontal or vertical).
hints: It has the same y-value for every x.
Think of $ f(x) = 5 $.
It is written with vertical bars.
It creates a V-shaped graph.
questions.prompt: The parent absolute value function is $ f(x) = $ ___.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: The parent absolute value function is $ f(x) = |x| $.

questions.prompt: What transformation does $ g(x) = f(x) + 4 $ represent?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ f(x) + 4 $ shifts the graph 4 units up.
hints: Adding a positive number outside the function moves it in a positive direction.
Outside changes go the way you'd expect.
Inside the function, the sign is opposite.
$ x - 2 $ means move to the right.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ x - 2 $ shifts the graph 2 units right.
questions.prompt: The graph of $ g(x) = f(x - 2) $ is a shift of the graph of $ f(x) $ by 2 units in which direction? (left or right)

hints: Put a negative sign in front of the function.
It flips the graph upside down.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ g(x) = -f(x) $ reflects the graph over the x‑axis.
questions.prompt: A reflection over the x-axis is represented by $ g(x) = $ ___ $ f(x) $.

hints: A stretch multiplies the y-values by a number greater than 1.
The 3 is outside the function.
questions.feedbackIfWrong: $ g(x) = 3f(x) $ is a vertical stretch by a factor of 3.
questions.prompt: Which equation represents a vertical stretch by a factor of 3?

questions.feedbackIfWrong: It is a vertical shrink by a factor of $ \frac{1}{4} $.
questions.prompt: If $ f(x) = x^2 $, what transformation does $ g(x) = \frac{1}{4}x^2 $ represent? (stretch or shrink)
hints: Multiplying by a number between 0 and 1 makes y-values smaller.
The graph becomes wider.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The domain of $ x^2 $ is all real numbers.
hints: You can square any real number.
There is no restriction on the input.

hints: Absolute value is never negative.

questions.prompt: The range of the parent absolute value function $ f(x) = |x| $ is $ y \ge $ ___.

hints: Remove the transformations to find the simplest form.
The absolute value function.

questions.prompt: If the point (2, 5) is on $ f(x) $, what is the y-coordinate of the transformed point on $ g(x) = f(x) + 3 $?
hints: Add 3 to the y-value.

questions.feedbackIfWrong: The parameter $ h $ controls the horizontal shift.
hints: It is inside the parentheses with x.
It shifts left or right.
questions.prompt: In the general transformation equation $ g(x) = a \cdot f(x - h) + k $, the parameter that controls the horizontal shift is ___.

hints: The 2 outside multiplies y-values (stretch).
The -3 outside shifts down.
questions.prompt: Which of the following describes the transformations of $ g(x) = 2|x| - 3 $ from the parent $ f(x) = |x| $?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It is a vertical stretch by 2 and a shift down 3.
